source: Final expert adjudications from analysis/CritPt/supplemental_data/verdict_review.json, restricted to the 56 challenges reviewed in the paper.

policy.problem: Judge the original task. clean includes manageable issues correctly resolved by the model; repairable requires a documented expert-provided substantive correction; unrepairable requires an explicit expert conclusion that no unambiguous repair is possible.
policy.model: Benchmark errors take precedence in audit attribution. For every repairable or unrepairable problem, set the model verdict to none regardless of whether the original answer was judged correct or incorrect. Assess model correctness only for clean problems. Historical expert assessments remain evidence, not active model attributions. This audit rule does not alter judgments or scores from separate corrected evaluations.
